# Pre-Implementation Readiness Checklist: Sudoku Solver

**Purpose**: Validate the requirements quality of the solver/validation logic,
UX/interaction flows, and overall spec completeness/consistency before moving
into `/speckit-tasks` and implementation.
**Created**: 2026-09-09
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are requirements defined for what happens when the user attempts to enter a digit outside 1-9 (e.g., 0, letters) into a cell? [Gap, Spec §FR-003]
- [ ] CHK002 Are requirements defined for how many/which example puzzles must be present beyond the minimum count (e.g., exact difficulty distribution)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Is there a requirement covering what the user sees while a "Solve All" or "Solve Next Digit" computation is in progress (a "solving" state)? [Gap, Spec §FR-005, FR-006]
- [ ] CHK004 Are requirements defined for whether/how a user can abandon entering a custom puzzle and return to an example without confirmation? [Gap, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for the maximum/minimum number of given digits a custom puzzle must have before it can be solved? [Gap, Spec §FR-003, FR-007]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is "clearly flagged"/"clearly inform the user" (conflict and unsolvable-puzzle messaging) quantified with a specific presentation requirement (e.g., inline vs. banner, persistent vs. transient)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-004, FR-007]
- [ ] CHK007 Is "visually distinguish" (given vs. solver-filled digits) defined with specific, testable visual criteria rather than left open-ended? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010]
- [ ] CHK008 Is the term "curated set" (Assumptions) of example puzzles clarified as to who curates it and by what criteria (beyond difficulty)? [Clarity, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "gracefully" (empty-grid solve handling in Edge Cases) defined with a specific, unambiguous expected behavior rather than left to interpretation? [Ambiguity, Spec Edge Cases]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK010 Are the reset behaviors described in FR-009 and the Edge Cases bullet ("re-selecting the same example puzzle resets it") consistent with each other in scope and outcome? [Consistency, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK011 Are the "Solve All" and "Solve Next Digit" requirements (FR-005, FR-006) consistent in how they treat puzzles with multiple valid solutions, per the Clarifications entry? [Consistency, Spec §Clarifications]
- [ ] CHK012 Do the real-time validation requirement (FR-004) and the solve-blocking requirement (FR-011) consistently define the moment at which a puzzle transitions from valid to invalid and back? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, FR-011]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK013 Can SC-003's "50 consecutive uses ... without error" be objectively measured/verified as written, including what counts as an "error"? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK014 Are the acceptance scenarios for User Story 3 sufficient to verify both the conflict-flagging and the unsolvable-puzzle messaging independently of each other? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK015 Is SC-005 ("0 authentication steps") paired with a defined set of user flows it must hold across, or only the primary flow? [Coverage, Spec §SC-005]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK016 Are requirements defined for the Alternate scenario where a user switches from one example puzzle directly to another while mid-solve (not via custom-entry)? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2]
- [ ] CHK017 Are requirements defined for the Exception scenario where the solver cannot determine solvability within the stated performance budget (SC-002/SC-003)? [Gap, Non-Functional]
- [ ] CHK018 Are requirements defined for the Recovery scenario where a user wants to undo a single "Solve Next Digit" step without a full reset? [Gap, Spec §FR-009]
- [ ] CHK019 Are requirements defined for concurrent/rapid repeated clicks on "Solve All" or "Solve Next Digit" before the prior action completes? [Coverage, Gap]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK020 Is the edge case of a custom puzzle with zero given digits explicitly resolved (handled gracefully vs. rejected), beyond "MUST handle this gracefully"? [Edge Case, Spec Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the edge case of a custom puzzle with exactly one given digit (minimum for classic sudoku uniqueness) addressed? [Edge Case, Gap]
- [ ] CHK022 Are requirements defined for what happens if the user tries to select an example puzzle while a custom puzzle has unsaved conflicting entries? [Edge Case, Gap]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [ ] CHK023 Are accessibility requirements (keyboard navigation, ARIA labeling per Constitution Principle V) reflected as testable functional requirements in spec.md, not only in the constitution? [Coverage, Gap]
- [ ] CHK024 Are responsive/viewport requirements (desktop and mobile per Constitution Principle V) captured as measurable success criteria in spec.md? [Gap, Spec §Success Criteria]
- [ ] CHK025 Are the performance budgets in SC-002/SC-003 tied to a defined reference environment/device class, or left device-agnostic on purpose? [Clarity, Spec §SC-002, SC-003]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [ ] CHK026 Is the assumption that "each bundled example puzzle has exactly one valid solution" validated by any documented process (e.g., authoring/QA step), or only stated as an assumption? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK027 Is the assumption that no cross-session persistence is needed validated against all four user stories, including whether a mid-solve refresh is acceptable to lose? [Assumption, Spec Assumptions]
- [ ] CHK028 Are dependencies on any specific browser capability (e.g., background computation for non-blocking solving) documented as a requirement or only inferred from the constitution? [Dependency, Gap]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [ ] CHK029 Is there a single canonical term used throughout for the action of loading a new puzzle (e.g., "select," "load," "choose") to avoid inconsistent terminology across FR-002 and User Story 2? [Terminology, Spec §FR-002]
- [ ] CHK030 Is a requirement & acceptance criteria ID scheme consistently applied and cross-referenced between spec.md, data-model.md, and contracts/ (e.g., FR-xxx referenced in contract docs)? [Traceability]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
- Link to relevant resources or documentation
- Items are numbered sequentially for easy reference
